x-current-work-items.title: TPEx 產業鏈資料基礎建置
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: 新增 industry_chains 與 tw_stock_master.industry_chain_codes。第一版已完成 D000 半導體資料，股票物件會回傳 stock.industry_chain_codes，前端可先建立產業鏈選擇器與產業鏈地圖的資料接法。

x-current-work-items.title: Consolidate ETF Supabase schema around etf_configs and canonical stock master
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: ETF config source table is now etf_configs. Legacy active_etf_* and etf_ingestion_runs tables were removed. Product APIs continue to return ETF/stock display fields through backend views, but frontend should treat etf_configs and stock object as canonical sources.

x-current-work-items.title: Remove etf_holding_snapshots.source_payload from product data path
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: ETF holding snapshot APIs no longer expose per-row source_payload. Use stock object, ETF fields, and fetch log metadata/Google Drive backups for audit needs.

x-current-work-items.title: ETF event OHLC enrichment and estimated trading amount
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: ETF event APIs now include event.ohlc for reference price, estimated amount, and market volume/turnover ratios. Stock overview also returns aggregated amount coverage and estimated buy/sell/net amounts.

x-current-work-items.title: Yuanta passive ETF 0050 source integration
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: 0050 is available through existing ETF/stock APIs. It is passive, so snapshots are saved only when composition changes; stock series may include carried-forward points.

x-current-work-items.title: 主動式 ETF 每日持股與進出資料
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: 先以 00403A 顯示目前持股，再複用到 00981A，00982A 由群益獨立來源接入；目前持股列表可帶 sparkline 與可用日期

x-current-work-items.title: 群益 00982A 來源接入與歷史回填
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: 後端先完成 00982A 群益 provider / parser / Drive 命名規則，前端本次不調整

x-current-work-items.title: 前台 API 文件展示頁
x-current-work-items.frontendEntry: 讀取 docs/openapi.json，顯示 API 用途、參數與範例回應

change_shares.description: Signed share change. Positive means buy/increase; negative means sell/decrease/sell_out.

delta_shares.description: Backward-compatible alias for change_shares when available.

current_shares.description: Latest current holding shares for the same ETF-stock pair. Returns 0 when the ETF no longer currently holds the stock.

event_shares.description: ETF holding shares on the first-buy event date.

current_snapshot_date.description: Latest current holding date for the same ETF-stock pair.

event_holding_ratio.description: Holding ratio on the first-buy event date.

current_holding_ratio.description: Latest current holding ratio for the same ETF-stock pair.

is_currently_held.description: Whether the ETF still holds this stock in the latest snapshot.

source_stock_name.description: Original stock name from the ETF source file/API. Use for audit/debug only, not product display.

is_carried_forward.description: True when backend inserted a synthetic point to keep passive ETF lines visible within the selected range.

EtfEventOhlcRef.description: OHLC-derived reference data for one ETF-stock event. Estimated amounts are calculated by the API view layer and are not stored in Supabase.

reference_price.description: Average reference price calculated as reference_turnover / reference_volume for the event display date.

reference_volume.description: Total market traded shares for the stock on the event display date.

reference_turnover.description: Total market turnover for the stock on the event display date.

estimated_net_amount.description: delta_shares * reference_price. Positive means buy/increase; negative means sell/decrease.

startDate.description: Inclusive start date for range enrichment.

endDate.description: Inclusive end date for range enrichment.

mode.description: missing only processes non-success rows; all processes every matching event row.

force.description: When true, re-enrich rows even if they already have success status.
